output.reason: Several weeks of episodic post-fatty-meal right upper quadrant pain without reported fever or jaundice fits a non-emergent biliary pattern, but a clinician still needs to arrange gallbladder imaging and labs, which messaging can start.
output.patientMessage: Please start a message review with a Counsel clinician in this thread in the next few days; your episodic right-upper-belly pain after fatty meals needs gallbladder imaging and blood tests arranged. Meanwhile, eating lower-fat meals may reduce episodes. Seek emergency care now if pain lasts more than a few hours, or you develop fever, chills, vomiting you can't stop, or yellowing of your eyes or skin.
differential: Peptic ulcer or reflux-related upper abdominal pain
